## Background and rationale

<!-- What problem does this address, or why is this change needed?
Include relevant use cases, reproduction steps, or issue links so reviewers do not need to look through earlier conversations.
Explain any implementation tradeoffs that need context. -->

## Changes

<!-- Describe what changed and the resulting behavior.
Explain any compatibility or data-format implications. -->

## Validation

<!-- List the commands and manual checks you actually ran, along with their results.
Keep local validation separate from CI results, and note relevant behavior that has not been verified. -->

## Screenshots

<!-- Remove this section if there are no UI changes.
For existing UI, include before-and-after screenshots. For new UI, include screenshots of the running implementation.
Label the relevant screen, state, viewport, and theme or language. See CONTRIBUTING.md for the full requirements.
Update screenshots when later commits change the UI they show. Keep the PR in draft until screenshot verification is complete. -->
